mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03, or the positive return rate falls below 55% in triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), labor market tightness supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.5, it signals strong economic output and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the expansionary momentum builds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) consistently indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to near-term demand signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it reflects a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) consistently erodes real corporate profits and increases the risk of aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
